correctness.rationale: Conditioning on L_{2n}=2k leaves the first 2k increments a bridge (future survival is independent) and makes the zero-free suffix sign symmetric. For the bridge the expected strict-positive count is k+1/2-1/(2u_{2k}), using E nonzero times and exact convolution sum_{r=0}^k u_{2r}u_{2k-2r}=1; suffix contributes n-k. Summation with P(L=2k)=u_{2k}u_{2n-2k}, sum_{r<=n}u_{2r}=(2n+1)u_{2n}, and sum r u_{2r}=n/3 sum u gives Cov(L,A)=-n(2n+1)u_{2n}/6 and normalized asymptotic -1/(12 sqrt(pi n)). Direct independent exhaustive ±1 path enumeration for n=1..6 matched all conditional means and covariances with rational arithmetic; the proof, not the enumeration, covers all n>=1.
